Subject: Re: Add-on charge for July (partial month) — need final invoice

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the PO.

Short answer: we prorated from July 18 (the date the add-on was enabled) to July 31 inclusive. I ran a quick allocation for your account and attached an Excel that shows the token-based charges, the fixed add-on fee, and the resulting prorated subtotal. The short breakdown:

- Full monthly add-on price: EUR 6,000
- Active days in July: 14 (Jul 18–31)
- Pro-rated add-on charge: EUR 2,709.68 (14/31 * 6,000, rounding to cents)
- Usage tokens during that window (generation tokens): 1.2M — charge EUR 360.00
- Subtotal (pre-tax): EUR 3,069.68

VAT/tax handling: since Aurabio is an EU company with an Italian VAT registration, under reverse-charge rules we typically zero-rate VAT on the invoice and include the reverse-charge note and your VAT ID on the invoice. Marissa from Billing is cc'd to confirm and add the formal wording.

I've attached the proration calculation (proration_calc_Aurabio.xlsx) and a draft invoice link — if Marissa can confirm the VAT phrasing and whether we should split the invoice between the monthly seat capacity and the add-on line items, we can issue the final invoice for your PO matching.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: please confirm reverse-charge wording and whether we need the full Italian billing address on the invoice.
2) Lena/Procurement: once Marissa confirms, we'll issue the final invoice and mark it as linked to your PO.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: proration_calc_Aurabio.xlsx (Excel)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Hi all — quick confirmation from Billing:

1) VAT/reverse-charge: for B2B supplies of digital services to an EU-registered business, we apply reverse-charge. We will set VAT at 0% and include the following on the invoice: 
   "VAT reverse-charge applies under Article 196 of the VAT Directive — recipient liable for VAT. Customer VAT ID: IT12345678901"

2) Billing address / PO matching: please confirm the exact invoicing address you want on file. We will use the billing address on the attached PO unless you provide a different legal address for invoicing.

3) Invoice splitting: we recommend a single invoice with separate line items for (a) monthly seat capacity (if any change this billing window) and (b) the prorated add-on. That keeps PO matching simple and keeps the accounting entry clear.

I reviewed Jonas' calc. The numbers look correct; we'll issue a final invoice with the rounding shown in the Excel and the reverse-charge language above. Once you upload the signed PO (or confirm the PO number), we will generate the final invoice and email a PDF.

Action items:
- Lena/Procurement: upload signed PO or confirm PO number and billing address (requested by end of week if possible).
- Jonas: please mark this invoice to reference DEAL-9743 in the invoice memo (helps collections).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
